Subject: [Escalation] Lumentech invite - iframe redirect causes accept to abort

Team — escalating because customer can't accept invite; reproduction attached (accept_link.html + request headers). Summary and repro below.

Summary:
- Invite URL appears to be served inside a Coupa iframe that then triggers a top-frame redirect to the customer's SSO (portal.lumentech.com). The browser blocks the redirect when presented inside an iframe which results in a blank preview and no progression to the acceptance form.
- Customer only sees this with Redwood invites (other buyers' invites succeed), which suggests the invite payload or the redirect target we include may be different.

Repro steps:
1) Use the invite URL: https://app.coupa.com/invite/accept?token=REDACTED (customer-provided)
2) Load the URL inside an iframe on a page that then issues a top-level redirect to https://portal.lumentech.com/sso-return
3) Chrome console shows: "Blocked top-frame redirect while in iframe"; user ends up on portal.lumentech.com without completing the accept flow.

Immediate asks / possible fixes:
- Can the invite be reissued with the query param view=standalone or mode=popup? That prevents embedding logic on some portals.
- If the token is single-use, we should invalidate the old invite and create a new invite with a non-embedded redirect target.
- Provide manual activation for suppliers@lumentech.com so PO flow isn't blocked while we patch.

Attachments referenced: lumentech_screenshot_01.png, lumentech_request_headers.txt, accept_link.html
